snippet.title: Michael Jackson Memorial - Daughter Paris speech
snippet.description:
The celebration of Michael Jackson ended on an emotional note when his rarely seen daughter, Paris, 11, stepped up to the microphone in tears to remember her father.
"Ever since I was born, Daddy has been the best father you could ever imagine," she said, surrounded by aunts Janet and La Toya Jackson. "And I just want to say I love him so much."

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Says Bond With Dad Michael Jackson Is "No One's Business" | E! News
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson’s daughter Paris Jackson has a message for her critics. The “Let Down” singer—who was 11 years old when the King of Pop died in 2009—shared that she no longer feels pressure to tell the world about the connection she had with her dad. In the past, Paris admitted she felt an expectation to publicly commemorate Michael—also dad to Prince, 29, and Bigi "Blanket," 24—on his birthday, death day and Father’s Day. "I'm now learning I can have my own personal relationship and I'm allowed to be private about it,” Paris said on the May 26 episode of the 'Trying Not to Die' podcast. “I'm now like, my relationship is the most beautiful relationship ever.” The 28-year-old added of her mindset shift, “I'm in a very beautiful spot with my dad and I love that and it's no one's business and I don't have to share that with anybody. And there's a lot of freedom in that, which is really cool." Full Story: https://www.eonline.com/news/1432360/michael-jacksons-daughter-paris-jackson-details-relationship-privacy

snippet.title: Paris Jackson & Prince Jackson Pay Tribute to Michael at Tony Awards 2022 'Our Dad Changed Music'
snippet.description:
Michael Jackson's children, Prince and Paris Jackson, honored him in a special way ... sharing kind words as they introduced a tribute performance of his Broadway musical at the Tony Awards.

The duo introduced a performance from "MJ the Musical" -- the Broadway show all about the making of Jackson's 1992 Dangerous World Tour.
Getty

Prince told the audience, "A lot of people seem to think our dad Michael Jackson changed popular music forever,' before adding: 'And, who are we to disagree?"
Getty

"But, what people may not know is he loved musicals, on film and on the stage. That's why we are so incredibly honored to introduce the night's first nominee for best musical, 'MJ', which, using many of his iconic hits, looks at the complexities and brilliance of our father's process."
myles frost as MJ

Paris added, it was a great honor to be on stage introducing the musical performance,  along with actor Myles Frost, who plays their dad ... and the rest of the cast. The show was nominated for 10 Tony Awards, including Best Musical.

Myles seemed to do their dad's role justice cause he also won Best Performance by an Actor in a Leading Role -- his first Tony ever!

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Finally Speaks On Her Father’s Last Day
snippet.description:
The world remembers the moment Paris Jackson stepped toward a microphone in July 2009. She was eleven years old, standing in front of thousands of people, with cameras aimed at her and her father’s casket nearby. She did not deliver a long speech. She did not explain the grief she was carrying. She said that Michael Jackson had been the best father anyone could imagine, then tried to tell the world how much she loved him. Her voice broke, and her family moved close to support her. In a few seconds, the daughter of one of the most famous performers on Earth became a child the entire world could suddenly recognize: a little girl who had lost her dad.

snippet.description:
Paris Jackson opens up about life as Michael Jackson's only daughter. While on 'Call Her Daddy,' the 28-year-old calls the late singer her best friend, and reflects on her headline-making speech at his memorial service, which she gave when she was only 11 years old. She reveals the emotional moment wasn't planned; she stepped up to speak only when her brothers, Prince and Bigi (aka Blanket) didn't. She also shares her experience of meeting biological mom Debbie Rowe for the first time at 15, and her nearly lifelong battle with addiction.

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Opens Up About Life After Michael Jackson 🥺
snippet.description:
Behind the fame of Michael Jackson was a little girl who simply loved her dad. 💔
When Michael Jackson passed away in 2009, his daughter Paris Jackson was only 11 years old.
Her grandmother, Katherine Jackson, later recalled how devastated Paris was after losing him.
Katherine also revealed that Paris surrounded herself with pictures of her father, wanting to keep his memory close.
Years later, Paris shared a small but touching childhood memory:
“I would just stare at my dad.” 🥹

snippet.title: Paris Jackson Makes RARE COMMENTS About 'Personal Relationship' With Late Dad Michael
snippet.description:
Paris Jackson makes rare comments about her 'private' and 'beautiful' bond with dad Michael on Jack Osbourne's 'Trying Not to Die' podcast. As she and Jack discuss their inherited fame, Paris explains why she no longer feels obligated to share details about her relationship with her late father on social media. Paris, who's launched her own music career, has become increasingly protective of Michael's legacy, even choosing to remove herself from the production of his biopic, 'Michael,' which shattered cinematic records when it hit theaters in April.
